description: Client routes of frontend/artifacts/neurostack/src/App.tsx that the API serves as the SPA shell (index.html). Test fixture only: tests/ is not copied into the image, so the API (src/api/spa.py) must hard-code its own route list and never read this file at runtime. tests/scripts/test_frontend_clean_checkout.py pins this file against App.tsx. Trailing-slash twins are derived by the server, not listed here. Routes in 'excluded' are served by the API itself and must never be registered as SPA routes.
